test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

The flames of the fire __leap into__ the air.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Leapt into.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the context of the given sentence, we can understand that it is talking about an incident happened in past.
 
• When we talk about any past incident, we always use v2 form.
 
• **'Leapt'** will be the past form of verb** 'leap.'**
 
• **'Leapt into'** will be the correct substitution in place of** 'leap into.'**

Therefore, the **correct sentence is:** *The flames of the fire **leapt into**__** the air*.
